title: Days 271–284 runtime and SQL measurement foundations

sources.title: PostgreSQL: Documentation: 18: 14.1. Using EXPLAIN
sources.use: Plan trees, estimates versus observations, buffer counters and measurement caveats; no preferred node/timing assertion.

sources.title: The jfr Command
sources.use: Read local Flight Recorder summary/events; local profiling rehearsal only.

sources.title: statistics — Mathematical statistics functions — Python 3.12.15 documentation
sections: Averages and measures of central location
sources.use: Interpret center and spread and state small-sample limits; no population/performance guarantee.

days.title: Capture a deterministic SQL baseline
days.task: Run prior gates read-only and capture the loopback PostgreSQL 18.6 synthetic workload. Record status without changing evidence.
days.evidence: Gate JSON, exact fixture rows and source/runtime identity; no completion inference.
days.shared_task: Question bank Q17 — Cache: accelerate a read; follow-up: state which measured read path and freshness requirement would justify a cache.

days.title: Verify the workload's relational facts
days.task: Derive expected owner/policy revisions from the seed rule; compare ordered result rows and include a foreign-owner counterexample.
days.evidence: Derived row set/order/count and foreign-owner counterexample; equality, not count alone.
days.shared_task: Question bank Q18 — Cache: invalidation after a write; follow-up: include tenant change and stale-version denial.

days.title: Implement exact result comparison
days.task: Implement full ordered expected-versus-observed row comparison and reject malformed row shapes.
days.evidence: Exact result fields and same-count foreign-owner negative through learner acceptance.
days.shared_task: Question bank Q13 — Booking: reserve one seat atomically; follow-up: reason about the final two concurrent requests.

days.title: Compare estimated and actual cardinality
days.task: Implement finite root estimated/actual row ratio including zero/zero and zero/nonzero cases.
days.evidence: Baseline ratio, 4x counterfactual and explicit zero mismatch; no node-name expectation.
days.shared_task: Question bank Q10 — Notification service: retries; follow-up: include a lost response after a worker timeout.

days.title: Report buffer observations
days.task: Extract nonnegative shared hit/read counters; note host and cache state influence observations.
days.evidence: Root hit/read values and negative-counter rejection through actual acceptance.
days.shared_task: Question bank Q22 — Webhook delivery: backoff and dead letter; follow-up: state the terminal failure and safe replay behavior.

days.title: Validate malformed plan evidence
days.task: Reject missing fields, wrong types, negative counters and nonfinite estimates; preserve valid report fields.
days.evidence: Valid case and exact malformed failures; no broad exception swallowing.
days.shared_task: Question bank Q12 — Scheduler: missed or duplicate execution; follow-up: worker stops after claim and before completion.

days.title: Compare plan and answer independently
days.task: Capture again in a clean disposable database; compare exact rows/counters and record planner variation.
days.evidence: Second-run result equality, changed/unchanged plan values and measurement limits; no stable timing claim.
days.shared_task: Question bank Q24 — Event pipeline: correction and replay; follow-up: include a side effect already emitted by the old projection.

days.title: Record a bounded JVM profile
days.task: Compile/run fixed CPU workload under local JFR; verify deterministic checksum and inspect summary.
days.command: mkdir -p /tmp/day278-jfr && javac -d /tmp/day278-jfr labs/runtime_sql/ProfilingWork.java && java -XX:StartFlightRecording=filename=/tmp/day278.jfr,dumponexit=true -cp /tmp/day278-jfr ProfilingWork && jfr summary /tmp/day278.jfr
days.evidence: Checksum, JDK version, JFR summary; tiny workload is not a service profile.
days.shared_task: Question bank Q02 — Short-link abuse and operations; follow-up: separate a CPU signal from a traffic-abuse hypothesis.

days.title: Inspect selected recording events
days.task: Print available execution samples from local recording; report absent event types without fabrication.
days.evidence: Actual output from capture; recreate with Day278 command if needed and record the action.
days.shared_task: Question bank Q09 — Notification service: accept and deliver; follow-up: provider unavailable after durable intent is recorded.

days.title: Relate runtime observations to workload
days.task: Repeat workload in two clean JVMs; compare checksums and event availability, not absolute timing.
days.command: for n in 1 2; do java -XX:StartFlightRecording=filename=/tmp/day280-$n.jfr,dumponexit=true -cp /tmp/day278-jfr ProfilingWork; jfr summary /tmp/day280-$n.jfr; done
days.evidence: Two outputs, equal checksums, event counts and sample-size limits.
days.shared_task: Question bank Q35 — Distributed rate limiting; follow-up: one region partitioned and fairness is required.

days.title: Re-run acceptance mutations
days.task: Run independent reference and mutation controls on learner acceptance paths for wrong rows, buffers and overclaim.
days.evidence: Reference assertions and mutation names caught; TODO remains uncredited.
days.shared_task: Question bank Q34 — Analytics: late and duplicate data; follow-up: replay a duplicate after a correction.

days.title: Explain a planner counterfactual
days.task: Change a copy of plan estimate/buffers and explain arithmetic without changing canonical bytes.
days.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import copy,json
from labs.runtime_sql.learner_analysis import analyze_observation
x=json.load(open('labs/runtime_sql/fixtures/observation.json')); y=copy.deepcopy(x); y['explain_json'][0]['Plan']['Plan Rows']=20
print(analyze_observation(y))
PY
days.evidence: Independent expected q-error 4.0, unchanged fixture SHA-256 and estimate limitation.
days.shared_task: Question bank Q27 — Feed: build a page; follow-up: new items arrive between pages and cursor stability matters.

days.title: Reproduce and compare the observation
days.task: Capture a third clean local fixture; compare full results and stable fields, record volatile timings separately.
days.evidence: Fixture identity, data/result equality, counters and volatile differences; no generic speed claim.
days.shared_task: Question bank Q32 — Streaming: adaptive delivery; follow-up: compare throughput and buffering under one regional failure.

days.title: Review gates and transfer the diagnosis
days.task: Re-evaluate prior gates, run analyzer and write bounded carry-forward selector plus diagnosis of an unfamiliar plan variant.
days.evidence: Raw dynamic gate outputs, lab results, independent diagnosis, next recovery and limitations.
days.shared_task: Question bank Q36 — Object-store recovery; follow-up: verify a restored object's checksum after accidental deletion.
